text.jp:
やあ、ようこそ救世主。
こんなところまでご苦労様です。
text.official_en:
Hello there. Welcome, Promised One. You must have
come a long way if you've found yourself here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
君の噂はダグシオンから遠く離れた
この場所にも届いていましたよ。
text.official_en:
Word of you has traveled all the way to this place,
so far from Dagsion itself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それにしても冥界の連中は容赦がありません。
……僕はあいつらはとても嫌いですよ。
text.official_en:
The forces of the underworld show no mercy. I've
got to say...I can't stand them.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そうそう、そういえば
僕は君に頼みたいことがあったのでした。
text.official_en: Ah, yes. There is something I'd like to ask of you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
イアペトス大洞窟という場所があるのです。
そこがちょっと悩みの種になってまして。
text.official_en:
Have you heard of the Iapetus Cavern? It's been
giving me something of a headache lately.
text.real_en:
Have you heard of the Great Iapetus Cave? It's been
giving me something of a headache lately.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
最近、あそこに火の山の炎の力が流れ込んだせいで
通れない場所ができてしまったのです。
text.official_en:
The flames from the Mountain of Fire have flowed
into the cavern, blocking any entry.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
炎の前で「フィンブルの夜」を使えば消火できる
とは思うのですが、魔道書を切らしていまして。
text.official_en:
Casting Fimbulvetr Night at those flames would put
them out. But I'm out of that particular magic tome.
text.real_en:
Casting Night of Fimbul at those flames would put
them out. But I'm out of that particular magic tome.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
昔ジュラに渡したことがあるから、もしかしたら
彼女の神殿で聞いてもらえば手に入るかもです。
text.official_en:
I gave that tome to Jurah quite some time ago. I'd
suggest that you ask her for it at her temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
僕に代わって、魔道書を手に入れ、
炎を消してきて貰えると助かります。
text.official_en:
I would appreciate you handling this in my place.
It'd be a great help.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その代わりに……最上級の兵種に挑めるなど、
戦いに役立つお礼を用意しましょう。頼みましたよ。
text.official_en:
In return, I'll give you something useful for your
battling—a chance to attempt a special master class.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
どうやら無事に消火してもらえたようで、
ありがとうございました。
text.official_en:
Well, it looks like you managed to put out the flames
safely. Thank you. This has been a great help.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの洞窟は魔道の実験のための素材集めに
重宝していた場所だったので助かりましたよ。
text.official_en:
That cave has been a handy spot for gathering
materials for my magic experiments.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
約束通り、お礼をさせてください。まず君が、
「ハイエピタフ」の試験に挑めるようにしましょう。
text.official_en:
I promised you a reward. I'll arrange for you to
attempt the <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:08>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それから、当神殿の神の道の門の使用を
君に許可します。
text.official_en:
I've also decided to let you use the Gate of the Gods
in this temple from now on.
text.real_en:
I've also decided to let you use the Gate of the Divine Path
in this temple from now on.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それから、私の所有する「至高のアーク」を
使える機会を特別にあげましょう！
text.official_en:
Finally, as a special treat, I'll give you a rare
opportunity to use a Supreme Arc that I possess.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アークを使うには決まりがありましてね。
神殿の試練をやり遂げる必要がありますが……
text.official_en:
There are rules for using such Arcs, you see. You
must first complete the temple's trial.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
君ならどうということもないでしょう。
挑みたければ、神官とよく話してください。
text.official_en:
I doubt you'll have any trouble with it, however.
Speak with the priests if you'd like to try.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
では、僕はそろそろダグシオンの様子でも
見に行くとしましょうか。
text.official_en:
With that, I think I should check on the state of
things in Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_スミルノス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今回は、ありがとうございました。
困ったことがあれば、また御願いしますよ。
text.official_en:
Thank you again for your help. I'll be sure to ask you
for anything more I need done in the future.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
これはこれは救世主様。
何の御用でございましょう？
text.official_en:
Ah, if it isn't the Promised One! What can I
do for you?

text.jp:
「フィンブルの夜」の魔道書でございますか？
たしかに、当神殿にて厳重に保管されております。
text.official_en:
A Fimbulvetr Night tome? We do have such a book in
secure care at our temple.
text.real_en:
A Night of Fimbul tome? We do have such a book in
secure care at our temple.

text.jp:
こちらは、もともとはジュラ様が
スミルノス様からお借りしたもの。
text.official_en:
It's a tome that Jurah once borrowed from
Smyrnos himself.

text.jp:
スミルノス様ご本人の頼みとあらば、お断りする
理由などございません。どうぞお持ちください。
text.official_en:
So, if this is at Smyrnos's request, I have no reason
to deny your taking it away.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
此処がスミルノスが言っておった場所じゃな？
ほれ、早う「フィンブルの夜」を使ってみよ！
text.official_en:
This is the place Smyrnos told us about, hmm?
Let's not waste time. Try using Fimbulvetr Night!
text.real_en:
This is the place Smyrnos told us about, hmm?
Let's not waste time. Try using Night of Fimbul!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イシュマール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: 無事に消火できたようだ。
text.official_en: It seems to have had no trouble putting out the flames.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
むう……炎が燃えさかっておって
先に進むことができんではないか……！
text.official_en: Hrm. The flames are burning too fiercely to proceed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
此処がスミルノスが言っておった場所か……
成程、これは一筋縄ではいかん。
text.official_en:
This must be the place Smyrnos was talking about.
'Tis a problem, no doubt.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
「フィンブルの夜」をいずれかの者に覚えさせ、
またここに来るのが良かろう。
text.official_en:
You should have someone learn Fimbulvetr Night before
we return to try again.
text.real_en:
You should have someone learn Night of Fimbul before
we return to try again.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イシュマール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: 激しい炎に阻まれ、先に進むことができない。
text.official_en: The fierce flames are blocking any progress.
